onboardedEditors.biography: Prof. Francis Verpoort is a Chair Professor at the State Key Laboratory of Advanced Technology for Materials Synthesis and Processing, Wuhan University of Technology, China, and an affiliated professor at Ghent University, Belgium. His research focuses on coordination chemistry, homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis, and advanced porous coordination polymers.

onboardedEditors.biography: Prof. Francesco Cacciola is an Associate Professor of Food Chemistry at the University of Messina, Italy. His research focuses on the development of innovative chromatographic and mass spectrometry techniques for the characterization of food lipids, polyphenols, and bioactive natural products.
